title: NSA purges Borland's JWICS document database

tellings.quote: So I had told you that in 2024 I had a large database saved of documents, briefings, private messages on classified on JWIX.

plain: In 2024, Dylan Borland says, he had a large saved collection of documents, briefings and private messages on JWICS, a classified US intelligence computer network, and the National Security Agency, the US electronic intelligence agency, wiped it. Borland tells Michels this as something that happened to him. He tells it as a sign that someone was working to remove material he had collected.
